statement: The turtle boundary is the only intrinsically immovable thing. Everything else is a body with mass; immobility exists only through the turtle, gluon anchors, or KINEMATIC solver mode. Nothing is ever placed or ends below the turtle plane beyond SLOP.
mechanism: assert_above_turtle at the particle doors + kg door (TURTLE_STRICT abort, TURTLE_LENIENT to inventory); enforce_turtle_boundary
origin: CLAUDE.md engine invariant; 55 below-turtle placements found 2026-08-10

statement: No two bodies interpenetrate beyond SLOP (1 mm) in steady state. Penetration resolves across frames at bounded speed; it is never accepted as rest state and never resolved by teleport.
mechanism: split-impulse position pass with SLOP tolerance; MAX_BIAS_VELOCITY bounds on repair speed
origin: settling/penetration gates; the 72 m/s wedged-boulder ejection RCA

statement: Energy is never created. Kinetic, potential and elastic strain energy may only transform into each other or into dissipation; the total never rises except through sanctioned external input (gravity, drives). A solver operation that adds energy is a bug wherever it hides.
mechanism: energy ledger (ENERGY_LEDGER=1): per-substep d_TOTAL by row type; equal-and-opposite momentum door
origin: owner's reframe 2026-08-10: energy is not lost, we transform it; Baumgarte-injection RCA

statement: Every generated structure, at frame zero and before a single solver iteration, has every bond at strain 1.0 (measured attachment-to-attachment) and no overlap beyond slop. No solver change can hold a structure that arrives already broken.

Compliance, soft constraints and spring-damper models exist only as physical models (OrganicGluon). Adding a spring or damping to suppress penetration, oscillation or a boundary symptom is forbidden; the mechanism underneath must be fixed instead.
mechanism: review discipline + the derivation law (INV-9) removing declared spring constants

statement: Every correction derives from contact geometry, never from a world-up axis. Every mechanism must work on walls, ceilings and in zero-g. Floor-Z clamps, push-up heuristics and axis biases keyed to world-Z are forbidden.
mechanism: contact normals from geometry; review discipline; turtle plane is geometry (a plane), not an up-vector

statement: The question 'can this body receive momentum' has exactly one answer, from one predicate (massless, sleeping, KINEMATIC: no), and every velocity write passes equal-and-opposite through one door. A sleeping body never gains velocity from any subsystem.
mechanism: inv_mass_momentum + apply_pair_impulse in physics_system_v4.cpp; position repair keeps its own deliberate predicate
origin: deeper-law campaign 2026-08-12: the sleeping-branch 6.74 m sink RCA

statement: No constraint row applies impulses sized for a different world than the one at solve time. Effective masses never exceed what the live immovability predicate allows; rows built before a wake shrink to the live state before solving.
mechanism: row mass refresh (shrink-only) for contact and gluon rows at solve start; manifold mass split (eff/N per same-normal row)
origin: 245 m/s blade RCA + heel-strike ±110 m/s RCA, 2026-08-12

statement: Organic bond force laws derive from material and geometry: axial k = A/(La/Ea + Lb/Eb), damping from loss factor, bending K = E*I/L. A force-bounded bond with no force law refuses to build. There is never a second declaration for the derivation to disagree with.
mechanism: derive_organic_force_law + refuse_undeclared_bond at both bond doors; GLUON_LENIENT=1 for inventory
origin: G6: 28 hollow branch bonds standing a canopy on nothing

statement: Any threshold, cap or exit criterion compared across bodies is expressed in a quantity with the same physical meaning at every mass: velocities, or momenta scaled by the mass they act on. A raw impulse threshold means a shrug to a branch and a shove to a leaf, and is forbidden.
mechanism: convergence exits, impulse-memory caps (m_light * max bias velocity), angular caps (I_light * max angular bias)

statement: No body exceeds the speed ceiling, leaves the world, or gains kinetic energy in a discontinuous jump. The explosion detector is always on; its warnings are failures, not noise.
mechanism: explosion detector (speed/energy/escape tripwires, frame-stamped), PHASE 8, always compiled in
origin: issue #42 tripwire; every detonation RCA of the campaign

statement: Contact normals and points come from bodies' actual oriented shapes. A rotated box collides as a rotated box, rests flush on its true faces, and sheds oblique loads sideways; nothing collides as its axis-aligned bounding slab.
mechanism: OBB SAT narrow phase with reference-face clipping; oriented bounds in broad phase and turtle down-reach
origin: walk-gate snowplow + settling_flat 276 mm RCA, task #40

statement: A driven joint converges to its commanded pose and holds it under its own load, without standing error beyond the test budget and without oscillation. The controller never fights a second controller: no integral terms stacked on drives.
mechanism: quat-drive rows + honest angular exits + scoped angular split impulse + FK/drive boundary contract; failed integral attempts preserved as evidence commits

statement: Bonds tear only under genuine geometric strain, measured attachment-point-to-attachment-point against the bond's own rest, at or beyond the tear ratio. A bond between two satisfied resting bodies never tears.
mechanism: tear law with rotated-offset rest; TEAR_DEBUG frame-stamped evidence lines
origin: foliage tear-at-rest RCA; the measure-what-the-bond-enforces lesson (G1c)

statement: The solver reads solver_mode and physical state only. No ParticleOwner or game-category branch exists inside src/core/physics_*.{h,cpp}; ownership bookkeeping lives in the systems that need it and is invisible to the solver.
mechanism: static audit (grep for owner reads in physics translation units); 28 cross-layer reads removed 2026-04-18
